Recommend a human check whether this GEM row corresponds to SNGPL's own 'HARIPUR-ABBOTTABAD' segment (8in, 52.53 km) plus an unlisted further extension toward Mansehra (Abbottabad and Mansehra lie on the same road/gas corridor, with Mansehra further up), which would explain both the diameter match and the length gap.
validity.researcher_notes: SNGPL's current 'Province-Wise Transmission Breakup' table (KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA) has no line explicitly named to Mansehra. The closest match is Sr#3 'HARIPUR-ABBOTTABAD', 8 in, MainLine = 52.53 km — diameter matches this row's Diameter=8, but the length (52.53 km) is well short of the sheet's 70.53 km. No SNGPL-listed segment continues the name to Mansehra, so I cannot confirm whether GEM's row is (a) this exact SNGPL segment mislabeled/misextended to Mansehra, (b) this segment plus an unlisted Abbottabad-Mansehra leg, or (c) a different line entirely. Geographically Mansehra sits further up the Hazara corridor beyond Abbottabad, which is consistent with (b). Separately: the drawn route here is 46 km, SHORTER than the stated 70.53 km (ratio 0.65) — the opposite direction from P4129/P4140/P4170 in this cluster. Given the corridor crosses hilly Hazara terrain (Haripur-Abbottabad-Mansehra), a schematic straight-line digitization undershooting the true winding pipeline distance is at least as plausible as the stated length being wrong, so I am not recommending a length change on the strength of the route measurement alone. Searched SNGPL AnnualReport-2023 full text for 'Haripur' and 'Mansehra' — both terms appear only in office-address listings (branch office addresses on Main Mansehra Road, Abbottabad), not in any pipeline project narrative. WebSearch quota was exhausted before a broader news-archive pass on this row could be run — an access gap, not a finding that no such source exists.
